description: Search the open AI training jobs (paid work training and evaluating AI models) across 57 platforms such as Mercor, micro1, Outlier, DataAnnotation, Alignerr and Invisible. Returns each role's title, platform, kind of work, advertised pay, where it is open and a link to apply on AITraining.jobs. All filters are optional.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. 'US', 'IN', 'BR'): only roles open to applicants in that country.

kind.description: Kind of work. One of the listed slugs, e.g. 'coding', 'rlhf-eval', 'multilingual'.

limit.description: How many roles to return (1 to 25).

min_hourly_usd.description: Only roles whose advertised hourly ceiling reaches this many US dollars.

platform.description: Platform slug, e.g. 'mercor', 'micro1', 'outlier-scale-ai'. get_ai_training_market lists them.

query.description: Keywords matched against role titles, e.g. 'physician', 'Python', 'Spanish', 'lawyer'.

name: search_ai_training_jobs
title: Search AI training jobs
